+def list_users(page: int, page_size: int) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
+    all_users = store.get_all_users()
+    total = len(all_users)
+    start = (page - 1) * page_size
+    end = start + page_size
+    users = all_users[start:end]
+    return users, total

+def handle_list_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw_page = params.get("page", "1")
+    raw_page_size = params.get("page_size", "10")
+
+    if not isinstance(raw_page, str) or not raw_page.isdigit() or \
+       not isinstance(raw_page_size, str) or not raw_page_size.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}
+
+    page = int(raw_page)
+    page_size = int(raw_page_size)
+
+    if page < 1 or not (1 <= page_size <= 100):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}
+
